## CALPQ change summary

Describe the smallest coherent change and why it is needed.

## Governance

- [ ] The change respects the CALPQ Constitution.
- [ ] The change does not bypass `M00 FOUNDATION` / feature freeze.
- [ ] New product ideas entered through `CALPQ-PRIPOJ` when applicable.
- [ ] Material architecture/technology changes have impact analysis and an ADR.
- [ ] Core/UI and plugin boundaries remain intact.

## Verification

- [ ] Foundation Guard passes.
- [ ] Required tests/reviews are identified.
- [ ] Security/privacy/legal/accessibility impact was considered where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation and provenance are updated.
